inputs.text: The International Olympic Committee has announced that DSD athletes and transgender women will be excluded from the female category at the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics and future Games in a landmark decision. IOC President Kirsty Coventry stated, “It would not be fair for biological males to compete in the female category,” adding that the move will protect fairness and safety.
